'''Norrin Vaxx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who had a low [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He ended up becoming a top contender in the gladiatorial [[Dool Arena]].

==Biography==
Born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Norrin had a natural ability to command [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] but his overall power was meager at best. Unable to rely upon his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] he turned to other avenues to get by, namely gambling and fighting. Over the years he had been slowly consumed by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Although he was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], his powers were so weak that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] did not bother to send anyone to hunt him down.

He eventually became a top contender in the [[Dool Arena]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]]. It was at the arena when [[Greel]], one of the arena's owners, matched Norrin up against a new challenger [[Lusubrin T'shkali]]. Norrin was disappointed with the match up as the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] challenger was still a new-comer to the arena.

==Personality and traits==
Norrin's fighting style was similar to his gambling philosophy in that he would take risks if he thought the rewards outweighed the danger.

He was average-looking with green eyes and silvery hair. He was also one of the oldest contenders in the Drool Arena.

==Powers and abilities==
Although he had learned quite a few different ways to control the Force, his powers were always very weak and had very little impact.

He did train with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was skilled enough in combat that he was able to become a top contender in the Dool Arena.

==Equipment==
In addition to his [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed lightsaber he carried a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]], although he was not allowed to use the blaster in the arena.

==Behind the scenes==
Norrin Vaxx was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].
